findings.claim: The BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull path can still throw IndexOutOfRangeException for a metadata member. GetPropertyIdentifierLocation claims to return null when no source declaration exists, but its body still indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]. The new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation wrapper cannot help because the exception occurs while constructing the diagnostic, before the wrapper is invoked. A closed generic struct from a referenced assembly with an unattributed public member therefore still has a path to CS8785 and AD0001, contrary to the acceptance criteria.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.ClosedGenericMetadataValueTypeReceiptTests.MetadataGenericStructMemberWithoutKey_DoesNotCrash from tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/Receipts/ClosedGenericMetadataValueTypeReceiptTests.cs. Its metadata Lib.Item<T> has an unattributed public property, exercising the changed BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull location path. The test fails while this helper indexes the empty DeclaringSyntaxReferences collection, and also checks for CS8785, AD0001, and generation of App.AppResolver.g.cs.
